# Trust The Skill Without Maintaining It By Hand

When an AI assistant needs judgment it can't get from validate alone, I want that guidance embedded once and surfaced identically through intent help and the generated skill, so the two can never disagree -- and I want the CLI to point the assistant at it at the moment it's needed.

## Skill And Help Share One Source

Minimize the chance that the installed skill's guidance disagrees with intent help's guidance.

### Skill And Binary Help Diverge

**Kind:** Risk

A hand-maintained skill file and the binary's embedded help are edited independently and drift apart.

### Skill Generated From Embedded Content

**Kind:** Requirement

install-skill must render the installed skill from the same embedded content intent help serves, never from a separately maintained file.

**Mitigates:**

- [Skill And Binary Help Diverge](#skill-and-binary-help-diverge)

## Judgment Reachable At The Point Of Action

Minimize the chance an assistant completes a write without knowing a relevant judgment topic exists.

### Agent Won't Fetch What It Doesn't Know It Needs

**Kind:** Risk

An assistant finishes a write without knowing there's guidance it should have checked, because nothing prompted it to look.

### Command Footers Nudge Judgment

**Kind:** Requirement

Every write command must print a footer naming the next likely command and the relevant judgment topic.

**Mitigates:**

- [Agent Won't Fetch What It Doesn't Know It Needs](#agent-wont-fetch-what-it-doesnt-know-it-needs)
